Not a duplicate of PPL_GA. Ga-Dangme is the grouping of two peoples: its own text calls it a compound made to group them, it gives two self-names (Ga, Dangme), two languages (gaa, ada) and lists Ga Mashie beside the seven Dangme branches (Ada, Krobo, Shai, Prampram, Ningo, Osudoku, Kpone), which PPL_DANGME documents. It is kept as a pure grouping: its two sub-group lines point to the Ga and Dangme fiches, and the origin and history accounts it repeated from them are removed (they are on PPL_GA and PPL_DANGME). It has no name history of its own. Ghana's census category Ga-Dangme still points at it.
